messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Bhai salam, OLX par mobile dekha tha. 22 hazar final karein ge?

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Salam! 24 hazar hai bhai, box pack bilkul new condition.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Chalen 23 kar do, cash on delivery type mil kar le loon Hafeez Centre se.

messages.speaker: me
messages.text: Theek hai 23 par deal. Kal shaam 6 baje mil jate hain, receipt likh dein ge sath.

messages.speaker: them
messages.text: Perfect bhai, kal milte hain. JazakAllah.
